premise: Down in the grass Caterpillar can't see the sky; Deer lowers his head and lifts her up high, and there is the whole sky — where Butterfly says she'll fly one day, as Butterfly was a caterpillar once too.
inspiration: The frog in the well (Chinese fable), who thinks the sky is only as big as the well's mouth; turned: a friend lifts you up to see the big world, and another shows you who you'll become.
lesson: Friends help us see further than we can alone.
learning: Caterpillars grow up to become butterflies.

en-US.title: Caterpillar Sees the Sky
en-US.text: [softly] Down in the grass lived {caterpillar:enter} Caterpillar. Grass to the left. Grass to the right. {sfx:grass} Grass, grass, grass. {butterfly:enter} Butterfly fluttered high above. [curious] What's up there? asked Caterpillar. {butterfly:hop} The sky! {caterpillar:face sad} Caterpillar stretched and {caterpillar:pulse} stretched. Still only grass. Then along came {deer:enter} Deer, on his long, careful legs. {deer:live} He bent down for a nibble, right beside her. [whispers] Climb on, said Deer. {caterpillar:go on deer} Up she climbed, and up… up… up went his head. {canvas:clouds 0.5 25s} {caterpillar:face surprised} [gasps] There it was. The sky! Big and blue, with white clouds sailing by. {caterpillar:live hold} Caterpillar reared up tall and gazed. {butterfly:face happy} {butterfly:go on deer} Butterfly {sfx:flutter} fluttered down and landed beside her. {butterfly:live} She rested her wings. One day you'll fly up there, she said. Me? I can't fly! I couldn't either, said Butterfly. I was a caterpillar once, just like you. {caterpillar:live resume} Caterpillar wiggled all over. {caterpillar:face happy} {deer:face happy} {deer:hearts} [happily] See you soon, sky, she whispered.

es-ES.title: Oruga ve el cielo
es-ES.text: [softly] Allá abajo, en la hierba, vivía {caterpillar:enter} Oruga. Hierba a la izquierda. Hierba a la derecha. {sfx:grass} Hierba, hierba y más hierba. {butterfly:enter} Mariposa revoloteaba muy por encima. [curious] ¿Qué hay ahí arriba? preguntó Oruga. {butterfly:hop} ¡El cielo! {caterpillar:face sad} Oruga se estiró y {caterpillar:pulse} se estiró. Nada, solo hierba. Entonces llegó {deer:enter} Ciervo, con sus patas largas y cuidadosas. {deer:live} Bajó la cabeza a mordisquear, justo a su lado. [whispers] Sube, dijo Ciervo. {caterpillar:go on deer} Oruga trepó a su cabeza, y arriba… arriba… arriba. {canvas:clouds 0.5 25s} {caterpillar:face surprised} [gasps] ¡Allí estaba el cielo! Grande y azul, con nubes blancas navegando. {caterpillar:live hold} Oruga se estiró bien alto y lo miró. {butterfly:face happy} {butterfly:go on deer} Mariposa bajó {sfx:flutter} revoloteando y se posó a su lado. {butterfly:live} Plegó las alas para descansar. Algún día volarás ahí arriba, le dijo. ¿Yo? ¡Si no sé volar! Yo tampoco sabía, dijo Mariposa. Yo también fui oruga, como tú. {caterpillar:live resume} Oruga se meneó entera de alegría. {caterpillar:face happy} {deer:face happy} {deer:hearts} [happily] Hasta pronto, cielo, susurró.
